# Velocity Influence

> Velocity Influence is a global marketing and PR platform plus full-service agency. We help businesses and agencies run multi-channel campaigns end-to-end — strategy, performance media, PR, AI intelligence, and creative — from a single workspace.

Operated by Global Solutions Management LLC (Delaware, USA).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Marketing platform plus agency for businesses and agencies.
- [Services](/services): Strategy, performance media, PR, AI intelligence, and creative production.
- [Industries](/industries): Healthcare, technology, finance, AI, professional services, retail.
- [Work](/work): Case studies and client outcomes.
- [Insights](/insights): Articles and reports on marketing, AI, and growth.
- [For Agencies](/for-agencies): Multi-workspace platform with white-label client portals.
- [About](/about): Who we are and how we operate.
- [Contact](/contact): Talk to the team.
- [Try the Demo](/demo): Explore the self-serve workspace without signing up.
